title: Adapt a release's checklist as we learn
statement: As a developer, I can add, reword, reorder and remove steps on one release, and add helpful excerpts to them, so one-off button presses and things to toggle before and after the release are not lost.
overview: The checklist is expected to keep growing while the work happens, so an agent or a person who notices "we'll have to flip this off first" writes it down there and then.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A step of a release can be added, reworded, moved and removed without changing the template or any other release.
A step can carry Markdown excerpts and pinned code references, and the reader shows them with the step.
Steps can be added and changed after other steps are checked, without unchecking them.
The reader marks which steps of a release did not come from the template.
